title: Tensor exactness and kernel flatness for a flat-quotient sheaf sequence
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Let $0\to F\to G\to H\to0$ be a short exact sequence of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], meaning a monomorphism followed by an epimorphism with image equal to kernel. Suppose $H$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For every sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $N$, the sequence $0\to F\otimes_{\mathcal O}N\to G\otimes_{\mathcal O}N\to H\otimes_{\mathcal O}N\to0$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] is short exact. If $G$ is also flat, then $F$ is flat.
